question: Does joint source-and-causal-hop learning on the real sensor distribution improve actual multiagent map fusion beyond the same source-only adaptation?
rationale: Frozen v294 fails K0 own-map fidelity in every room-count stratum, before communication. Independent first-principles reviews agree that frozen-E/D precision-only fitting is not admitted. Adapt the existing active model, not another head or a larger message.

parent.loader: Original typed ContentReadout64.from_payload; sole pinned parent, no ancestor reconstruction
parent.trainable: All existing ACTIVE encoder, mean head, precision head, lift and decoder parameters. Original unused source lift/decoder stay frozen. Fixed parent normalization stays fixed.
parent.unchanged: 64-dimensional source mean plus64-dimensional diagonal uncertainty, original identity/equality restriction, hard8 representation and original map heads. No private map overwrite, skip, teacher/oracle input, new loss term or new network head. Historical checkpoint/demo untouched.

data.split: Generator world identity includes TRAIN or VALIDATION before geometry/poses; N variants share physical world and are not independent replicates. TEST forbidden.
data.sensors: Original first-hit occluded5m observations from three short actual poses; no rectangle mask replacement, no resizing, no outcome-based resampling.
data.source_input: Each original factor is computed from that agent's own raster only. Experiment batches store several sources centrally for parallel simulation, not as per-agent global knowledge.
data.cache: Cache deterministic original rasters and public geometry/schedules on CPU or disk; targets derive only from actually reached originals. Save hashes. Do not cache a stale learned factor across optimizer updates.
data.scope: This is native128 learning admission, NOT native256/512 neural recovery. The larger-scale full goal remains active.

common_protocol.topology: Deterministic BFS spanning forest of the original physical radius adjacency: lowest unvisited root ID, sorted neighbors. Retain all agents including isolated nodes and original cyclic adjacency in manifests.
common_protocol.schedule_authority: OFFLINE PUBLIC SCHEDULE, not a deployed distributed tree-construction algorithm. Discovery, forest construction and setup unmeasured costs are explicit unknowns, not zero. No whole-process100x claim from this pilot.
common_protocol.source_once: Original source q and h immutable during an episode. Synchronous directed cavities exclude immediate reverse edge; incoming messages replace rather than accumulate. Forest guard rejects cycles; no posterior or decoded map reinjected as a new source.
common_protocol.prior: Original public prior lambda=0.0001 split lambda/(N*64) per source. Partial reached source set S has sum(data_q_i)+|S|*lambda/(N*64), not a silently full global prior.
common_protocol.codec: Separate profile4 log precision[1e-8,128], same64 information and64 precision hard8 scalars and existing172-byte application schema. Do not mutate old profile3 or monkeypatch shared code. No clipping; overflow is fatal.
common_protocol.codec_bound: For N<=16, at most15 source contributions and15 quantizers per outgoing path; rho=(128/1e-8)^(1/(2*254)). (15*4+15*lambda/(16*64))*rho^15=119.286831<128, with an explicit FP32 rounding allowance checked by tests. Old profile3 max16 is insufficient for general N16.
common_protocol.labels: Union of ORIGINAL rasters actually arriving over the selected forest at each stage, not original all-edge radius k-hop union. Save reached-source bitsets, source/target hashes and graph-distance differences.
common_protocol.admission: CPU chain/star/branch/disconnected/isolated tests; FLOAT beliefs match each partial central source-sum reference; literal serialized receiver matches tensor inference; duplicate/stale/out-of-order checks; fixed-source stability after tree diameter; finite nonzero mu/q gradients; immutable originals; actual loop rejection. Zero-update old-profile3 versus new-profile4 differences disclosed.
common_protocol.h_R_L: Forest transmission roundR is not necessarily original radius graph distanceh. Local calculationL is distinct. Repeated stable messages cannot manufacture source information or extra precision.

training.same: Pinned initial weights, all deterministic source-scene draws, fixed normalization, codec, supervised map loss, updates and optimizer schedule. Report extra causal-arm compute, not matched FLOPs.
training.batch: One complete N8 or N16 scene per update; recipient losses averaged within the scene. Explicit memory-safe choice before any fitting, not hidden reduction from the old two-scene microepisode recipe.
training.optimizer: Fresh AdamW; weight_decay0; no claim of optimizer resume
training.L: Existing reconstruction_terms: known BCE over every pixel plus wall BCE only on target-known pixels, normalized by known count, then mean recipients. No wall class weighting, topology auxiliary or unavailable full-map target.
training.primary_endpoint: 4000 updates, not the best retrospectively selected metric. Intermediate checkpoints retained. Truncation is incomplete, not failure or convergence.
training.launch_gate: Root code read, independent review, CPU tests, pinned source bundle and zero-update actual-device timing/gradient/wire preflight must pass before numerical fitting. Time estimate including registered evaluations must fit cap; failure is a resource outcome, no silent scientific/step change.

evaluation.aggregation: Agent means within scene, then scene means per room-count and N; also show all strata individually. Shared physical worlds are paired; no false independence across N variants or hop stages.
metrics: original v211 four-neighbor target-free pair connectivity
evaluation.stage_coverage: Report actual transmission R0/1/2/4/8 separately. h>=2/h>2 cohorts use ORIGINAL PHYSICAL radius-graph shortest distance, intersected with ACTUALLY arrived original sources. Preserve selected-forest route>=2/route>2 cohorts separately; a physical1-hop source delayed by the tree must not be mislabeled physicalh2. Cohorts require novel received cells, with eligible recipient/scene denominators. No-new-evidence receivers kept and labeled, not dropped to inflate gains.
evaluation.K0_prerequisite: Both endpoints, each room-count: own accuracy>=90%, own wallF1>=75%, unknownFPR<=5%. Otherwise interpretation remains source representation/domain-transfer limited.
evaluation.material_joint_gain: At R2 and R8, each room-count candidate versus source-only: union>=3pp and peer wallF1>=10pp. Actual novel received evidence from physicalh>=2 required atR2 and physicalh>2 atR8. If the fixed distribution provides no such coverage, result is inconclusive, not grounds to change the graph or denominator after outcomes.
evaluation.protection: Candidate versus control: K0 and fused own accuracy/known recall/wallP,R,F1 drops<=1pp; door/topology drops<=2pp; FPR increase<=0.5pp and FPR<=3%. Also compare candidate fused own facts against its own K0. Missing metric coverage is inconclusive.
evaluation.full_fidelity_target: Report distance to99% raw fidelity and98% wallP/R separately. Pilot admission is not the full scientific goal.
evaluation.fixed_visuals: Save unpostprocessed local input, arrived union GT, known/wall logits and raw ternary output for VAL index0 all6 room-count/N profiles at all registered stages; no hand-picking successful examples.
evaluation.communication: Count actual full directed-forest transmissions and bytes for evaluated simulated episodes. No inferred100x: routing/setup/discovery not yet measured and no matched forest raw transcript yet. Existing v293 full-radius raw ledger remains separate; do not divide costs from different graphs/schedules.
evaluation.after_each_completed_training: Independent multiagent FIRST-PRINCIPLES review of raw maps, packets, gradients, losses and historical evidence. Do not modify the still-pending paired arm, adapt thresholds, or select a new intervention until this registered pair is complete or explicitly resource-truncated. Supplemental literature only when useful.

execution.credits_guard: Check before newbatch/longagentwork/autocontinuation; strictly<3000 invokes existing human-authorized save/safe-pause. Unknown not safe.
